prefab.name: Nextcloud
prefab.description: Nextcloud file sync and collaboration, with its MariaDB database.

db_password.help: Generated at deployment, shared by Nextcloud and MariaDB.
db_password.label: Database password

admin_password.help: Generated at deployment and used at the first start only: change it in Nextcloud afterwards.
admin_password.label: Administrator password

upload_limit_mb.help: Largest file sent in one request. Bigger files go through the desktop or mobile clients, in chunks.
upload_limit_mb.label: Upload limit (MiB)

config.description: Nextcloud configuration, written by the installation.

kuro-config.description: Site address and proxy settings, rewritten on start.

cron.help: Runs cron.php once. Schedule it every 5 minutes, after switching Nextcloud to cron mode.
cron.label: Run background jobs

repair.help: occ maintenance:repair, as asked by the admin overview warnings.
repair.label: Repair

upgrade.help: occ upgrade, after the prefab moved to a newer Nextcloud image.
upgrade.label: Finish an upgrade

use-cron.help: Switches Nextcloud from AJAX to cron mode (occ background:cron): run it once, then schedule the cron action.
use-cron.label: Use cron for background jobs

files-scan.help: occ files:scan --all: picks up files added outside Nextcloud. Can take long on big volumes.
files-scan.label: Rescan files
